description: A local, multi-agent Figma-to-HTML workflow with immutable run state and four independent release gates.

modules.label: Governance and guidance
modules.description: Defines repository purpose, commands, security boundaries, and guideline precedence.

modules.label: Figma workflow skill
modules.description: Orchestrates Figma extraction, candidate construction, independent QA, repair, and release.

modules.label: Codemap skill
modules.description: Builds and queries the durable workspace map used for repository orientation.

modules.label: Claude adapter
modules.description: Configures Claude subagent roles and skills.

modules.label: Lifecycle state controller
modules.description: Creates and transitions projects, pages, sources, runs, candidates, QA records, and releases.

modules.label: Artifact contracts
modules.description: Defines machine-readable schemas and example structures for sources, runs, specifications, content, and QA.

modules.label: Rendering and QA evidence
modules.description: Serves and renders candidates, measures browser output, compares pixels, verifies accepted evidence, and generates the four human-reviewer QA DOCX deliverables (overview, design, content, coding).

modules.label: Validation and tests
modules.description: Checks repository integrity and exercises lifecycle invariants and mapping behavior.

modules.label: Project workspaces
modules.description: Provides the versioned template for project-local guideline workspaces while runtime project state remains outside the architecture map.
